name: Liquid-flow actuation qualifier
summary: A liquid-flow qualifier identifies the process input operating a device.
description: A liquid-flow qualifier identifies the process input operating a device. A flow-operated device responds to the movement of liquid through a documented process path. It can supply a switching condition without being a quantitative flow meter.
For a cooling-water interlock, keep the process connection, switch output and permissive logic separately identifiable. The circuit symbol does not supply the selected flow setting.
readingNotes: Show the process connection and the contact normal state separately.
The qualifier does not establish a flow threshold or measuring accuracy.
drawingChecklist: Identify the associated device, circuit or diagram boundary.
Show the process connection and the contact normal state separately.
Cross-reference the equipment data, terminal mapping or operating-state legend needed to interpret the form.
distinction: The qualifier does not establish a flow threshold or measuring accuracy.
